messages:
harper-eng: deploy-bot flagged a late-window spike for rerank (rerank:v1.9.0). p95 +28%, error 2.1% over baseline. deploy-bot suggests AUTOREVERT. tagging @raj-oncall @joel-sre for handoff.

deploy-bot: ALERT -> AUTOREVERT_RECOMMEND. Criteria: p95>200ms for 4m and err>1.5% for 3m. Canary slice=10%. Options: AUTOREVERT or MANUAL_ROLLBACK.

joel-sre: grabbing region split and trace logs. if it's regional manual rollback preferred so we can pin dedicated pools.

ops-bot: telemetry: us-west-1=78% canary traffic, p95_usw1=225ms, p95_eu=170ms, error_rate=2.1%. runtime-node-gpu-21 shows elevated latency. no infra alerts.

mina-prod: We have dedicated customers on this route. manual rollback + pin to v1.8.9 to avoid oscillation. also need a one-line release note.

raj-oncall: I'll take. plan: 1) pause canary, 2) set pin rerank:v1.8.9, 3) disable autopilot for this release, 4) run rollback playbook, monitor 10m. Joel, can you run commands?

joel-sre: running:
```
deployctl traffic pause --release rerank:v1.9.0 --slice canary
deployctl release pin --service rerank --version v1.8.9 --reason "rollback: late-window latency & errors"
deployctl annotate --release rerank:v1.9.0 autopilot_disabled=true
```

ops-bot: checklist posted + runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/playbooks/rollback-rerank

joel-sre: pause done, pin applied, autopilot disabled. starting rollback job rb-50432.

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual rollback by joel-sre; autopilot suppressed.

joel-sre: replicas back on v1.8.9, healthchecks passing. p95_usw1 down to 160ms after 3m, err 0.3%. monitoring 10m.

lucy-pm: drafted customer note in #customer-comms. will send after ops clears. Mina, please notify Dedicated owners to hold pin until RCA.

ops-bot: incident INC-50432 created for RCA assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime. tags: latency, gpu-21, canary

raj-oncall: 10m stable. closing rb-50432. harper, update release notes & lock window for 24h.

harper-eng: updated notes: "Rolled back rerank v1.9.0 to v1.8.9 due to latency and error spike in late change window; investigation ongoing." pin locked 24h. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
